response.rationale: All options are unmatched. Options C and D have the highest confidence scores (0.9) and are related to each other (C is a specific type of D). Option C is more specific than D, so it is ranked higher. Options A and B have lower confidence scores (0.1) and are unrelated to the top options. There is no clear clinical closeness between A and B to the top leaves, so they are ordered arbitrarily after C and D.
